title: Thai-Style Oven Curry Tofu
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired dish made with oven-roasted tofu in a rich curry sauce, served with toasted bread.
instructions: Cut the tofu into bite-sized cubes and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with a little oil and toss to coat. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the curry paste and cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Add the fish sauce (if using) and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Add the roasted tofu to the skillet and toss to coat with the curry sauce.
Serve the tofu and sauce over toasted bread.
Garnish with fresh cilantro or basil, if desired.
